env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# An exported alias with an optional field backed by a cloned generic
# pointer type imports cleanly.
cd good
logos run .
stdout '^alias-import ok true$'

-- good/go.mod --
module example.com/optaliasimp

go 1.27
-- good/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type Target struct{}

func (Target) Find() int? { return nil }

type Ref[T any] *Target

type API = struct{ Value Ref[int]? }
-- good/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/optaliasimp/lib"
)

func main() {
	var a lib.API
	fmt.Println("alias-import ok", a.Value == nil)
}
